newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rain moves to Paris area, more forecast at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Rain moves to Paris area, more forecast at weekend.

text.p: Light rain fell on western France on Friday and more rain over the next four days may give bring some relief to thirsty grain and sugar beet crops, the national meteorogical service Meteo France said.
On Friday morning Brittany had light rain and scattered showers reached the Paris area by the afternoon.

At 1322 GMT Meteo France was reporting light rain over Paris and there was more steady rain over the Normandy coast and the Nord-Pas-de-Calais regions. Another rainy front is expected to hit Brittany on Saturday morning and more rain is expected over France's southwest on Sunday and over the norh on Monday. Scattered showers are also forecast for Tuesday.
